other_conditions: Student must be pursuing an undergraduate programme in SAUs/DUs/CAU/CUs of NARES in courses accredited by the National Agricultural Education Accreditation Board (NAEAB) of ICAR
Student must maintain merit and good conduct as certified by the Head of College/University/Institution
Student should not remain absent during the programme without prior permission of the Competent Authority
Student should not participate in any agitation or strike
Student must not take up any part‑time job or receive any other financial assistance for such activities during the programme
benefits_summary: Stipend of Rs. 3,000 per month (Rs. 2,500 ICAR share + Rs. 500 State share) for up to six months, plus an additional Rs. 500 per month for operational expenses.
